title: VUA inspection.get (v0.1)
description: Reads one inspection evidence document by identity (full validation in schemas/inspection-evidence/v0.1/inspection-evidence.schema.json). DRAFT (proposal 016 arbitration point 2: independent vocabulary row, get/list after the record.get/list precedent; delivered by the data role 2026-09-13 after the production M7 anchor slice c33adb3 was accepted into main — NOT frozen, not registered: the freeze lands with hard precondition 2, the core storage+routing implementation batch, together with the inspection-evidence body freeze). The read face returns the evidence body verbatim — the honest detail lives in the document (referenced, never inlined, never re-derived). The document itself is AMF production persistence domain; it never passes through BDL (proposal 016 §5, proposal 011 §5).

inspectionId.description: VUA-generated inspection identity (uuid v7), same identity convention as the production-evidence entry (W23) and the inspection-evidence body schema. Consumers reference it, never re-derive it.

inspectionDocument.description: The inspection evidence document body, validated in full by schemas/inspection-evidence/v0.1/inspection-evidence.schema.json (kept as a loose object here so the method face does not pin a draft sibling's revision detail; the consumer test anchors the double validation).
